sentences.text: This young {sex} southern elephant seal, a {stage}, was tagged at {release_site} and tracked from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Southern elephant seals are the largest seals, and adult males are several times heavier than females.
His track reached as far south as {southernmost_lat}, and on {farthest_date} he was {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began.
At sea, elephant seals dive almost continuously, spending only minutes at the surface between dives.
His deepest recorded dive went to {deepest_dive_m}, and his longest lasted {longest_dive_min}.
Over {days_tracked}, his daily positions add up to {path_km}.
